summary: Repository auto-merge was enabled in OpenTofu, but the bootstrap Conftest policy still required allow_auto_merge to be false, so Release refused every repository-policy apply ("repository must delete merged branches and prohibit automatic, squash and rebase merges") and stopped before deploying. The policy now allows auto-merge, which still waits for the main ruleset's required checks and resolved conversations, and keeps refusing squash and rebase merges.
